hotels.title: Stylish Grand Mercure Kuala Lumpur Stay in Vibrant Bukit Bintang
hotels.description: Step into polished city glamour in Bukit Bintang, where this refined retreat places you moments from Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, Jalan Alor’s famed street-food stalls and the designer boutiques of Starhill Gallery. The hotel’s contemporary interiors pair warm Malaysian touches with sleek rooms and suites in one of Kuala Lumpur’s most dynamic neighbourhoods. Between outings, swim in the outdoor pool, keep to your routine at the fitness centre or settle in for all-day dining at the onsite restaurant. The nearby MRT and monorail links place Petronas Twin Towers, KLCC Park and the bars of Changkat within easy reach
